en: Black‑and‑white street scene showing a man in a suit and cap posting or collecting mail from a street mailbox beside a wide, busy road. Several 1960s-era cars are parked or driving past; one car in the foreground has a crown-and-horn postal emblem on its door. In the background are waterfront buildings and a bridge-like roadway lined with streetlights and overhead wires. The image has the look of a documentary or tourist postcard from a Northern European city.
